title: QUIC RFC 9000 Peer Connection-ID Lifecycle Runtime Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home execution, protected packet inspection for RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID emission, SpecTrace validation, and coverage-triage regeneration.
scope: This verification covers the bounded runtime peer connection-ID lifecycle seam: outbound peer CID switching after NEW_CONNECTION_ID, consumed peer CID preservation after validated path migration, peer-issued connection-ID active set maintenance, increased Retire Prior To cleanup, protected RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID emission for retired lower sequences, local CONNECTION_ID_LIMIT_ERROR handling for peer active-set excess, bounded pending retired-sequence tracking, continued acceptance of locally issued connection IDs until the peer retires them, and local issuance rejection/replenishment behavior when an additional issued ID would exceed or fit within the peer limit.
expected_result: Focused tests prove positive, negative, and edge coverage for local and peer active connection-ID limit handling, peer-issued connection-ID set maintenance, outbound packet protection under the newly selected peer CID, migrated-path sends that retain the consumed peer CID rather than the stale handshake CID, Retire Prior To retirement ordering, pending-retirement capacity, no-forget-before-retire state preservation, local route retention until peer retirement, and zero Retire Prior To replacement issuance. Nearby S19P15/S19P16 regression homes remain green so the existing frame-codec and RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID protocol-violation behavior is preserved.
procedure: Run the focused RFC 9000 peer connection-ID lifecycle requirement-home tests and nearby S19P15/S19P16 regression homes.
Run the focused S5P1P2-0001/S5P1P2-0002 requirement-home tests that inspect outbound packet protection under the selected peer CID before and after validated path migration.
Run the focused S5P1P2 requirement-home test filter after the pending-retirement implementation and trace wiring.
Confirm protected RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID emission by opening the protected application-data packet and scanning the payload frames.
Render and check touched SpecTrace artifacts.
Regenerate the QUIC requirement coverage triage.
preconditions: The runtime has a validated active path and 1-RTT packet protection material.
The peer NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame is received on the protected application-data path.
The local active_connection_id_limit defaults to the RFC 9000 minimum when the test bootstrap transport parameters do not explicitly set it.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification intentionally does not claim S5P1P2-0006 or S5P1P2-0007 packet-association and address-pair discipline; full S9P5 migration discipline; preferred-address transition behavior; new local route registration beyond already issued local CIDs; public migration APIs; multipath behavior; or interop-runner migration success.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-04 after the S5P1P2-0001/S5P1P2-0002 tail update. Build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors; the focused 0001/0002 requirement-home filter passed 2/2; the full S5P1P2 requirement-home filter passed 29/29; core SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 373 artifacts; the QUIC coverage triage regenerated with S5P1P2-0001 and S5P1P2-0002 trace_clean and only S5P1P2-0006/S5P1P2-0007 still uncovered_unblocked in the group; the full no-build solution test pass completed 4080/4080 under -m:1.
